poin.isi: Tencent's Hunyuan Speech team and researchers from several universities introduced Gander: a model that processes speech, images, and text at the same time, can be interrupted at any moment, and keeps working on heavy tasks in the background — fixing a bug while you keep asking questions.

The work is split in two: one part keeps the conversation flowing second by second, another handles long tasks — and that work brain can be swapped for other agent systems such as Codex or Claude Code without retraining. Honest caveat: on Full-Duplex-Bench v3, Gander had the best timing (interrupting users in 8% of cases vs 13.5% for GPT-Realtime), but its task accuracy still trails the weakest competitor.

An AI assistant no longer has to stop talking while it works. And because the work brain is swappable, you do not rebuild everything each time a new model appears — you replace the engine, the workflow stays.

headline: AI CAN NOW TALK
WHILE IT GETS WORK DONE
headline_caption: Tencent introduces Gander: an AI model that holds a live conversation while working on tasks in the background
subjudul: Tencent splits the talking brain from the working brain — conversation stays smooth, tasks keep running.
